# Simka Cat Productions

> Simka Cat Productions is an independent television studio in Burbank,
> California, founded in 2026 by Mychal Simka and Trevor Rothaus. It develops
> kids' series — starting with the three-show Triple Threat slate — built on
> chaos and slime up front, with real character arcs underneath.

- Studio: Simka Cat Productions
- Founded: 2026
- Headquarters: Burbank, California, USA
- Website: https://simkacat.com/
- Status: In development. No series has an air date yet.
- House motto: "If it doesn't make a grown-up slightly nervous, it's not done yet."
- Tagline: Simka Cat. Turn it up.

## Founders

- **Mychal Simka**, co-founder. Cast, directed, and produced twelve animated
  features for Lionsgate, working with voice talent including Ariana Grande,
  Hilary Duff, and Smash Mouth. The studio is named after him.
- **Trevor Rothaus**, co-founder. Runs a nonprofit animation studio and
  engineered its production pipeline end to end — story, animation, voice,
  edit, delivery. Previously a core developer at SendGrid, from Series C
  through its acquisition by Twilio.

## Shows

All three are part of the **Triple Threat** franchise — named for a performer
who can sing, dance, and act — and all three are in development.

- **Triple Threat: Off the Wall** — scripted live-action series. At a
  performing-arts high school, students chase stardom by day and fight real
  demons after the bell. This is the flagship.
- **Triple Threat: Z Factor** — unscripted competition series. A nationwide
  talent hunt where kids have to sing, dance, and act to survive each round.
- **Triple Threat: Bootcamp** — docu-reality series. Contestants move into a
  live-in training camp run by Broadway vocal coaches and world-tour
  choreographers.

## Simka Cat snacks

A brand-world snack line, not yet on sale: Scrapple, Sludge (orange, green,
and purple), Bloobs, Bloodbath Catsup, Old Fashioned Kitty Chow, and Catnip
Seasoning. Nearly all of it is labeled as being for humans, not cats.
